description: Client for the Busy Meter status light's local plugin API (127.0.0.1 only). No third-party packages.
Provides a plugin that integrates cloud transports with FastReport .NET, FastReport WPF and FastReport Avalonia. Requirements: Any FastReport 2027.1.0.0+ package, NuGet Client 3.4.4+.
Provides transports for saving and loading reports in cloud storage services.
